question.text: 'Godavari Impact AIF' (Category II) must carry out annual PPM compliance audit. By when must the audit findings along with corrective steps be communicated to the Trustee, Board of Manager and SEBI?

answer.text: Within 30 days from the end of the financial year
Within 3 months from the end of the financial year
Within 6 months from the end of the financial year
Within 12 months from the end of the financial year

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.2, the findings of the PPM compliance audit, along with corrective steps if any, shall be communicated to the Trustee or Board or Designated Partners of the AIF, Board of the Manager, and SEBI within 6 months from the end of the financial year. The Trap: 30 days is a short-window distractor used in other PPM-related intimations. 3 months is not the prescribed window. 12 months is too late — the regulator requires timely post-FY-end compliance reporting. Note: The 6-month communication clock starts from the end of the financial year and applies to all three recipients together: Trustee/Board/Designated Partners, Board of the Manager, and SEBI.
